definition.name: Rebuilt Rust standard stdio and signed ordinary libraries

steps.name: Install the existing bounded compiler namespace and pinned bindings
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Download this run's existing public native and companion products
Test pinned stdio source and actual PAL host reference
steps.run:
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_rust_standard_logging tools.tests.test_rust_standard_logging_campaign
python3 tools/run_rust_stdio_reference.py --rustc "$(rustup which rustc)" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-stdio-reference"

steps.name: Build owned closed and logging std and execute ordinary signed libraries
Retain bounded stdio observations including failed attempts

with.name: rust-standard-stdio-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-stdio-reference/qualification.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-stdio/qualification.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-stdio/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-stdio/*-capture.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-stdio/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-stdio/*-std/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-stdio/*-std/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-stdio/*-build/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-stdio/*-build/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-stdio/*-build/component.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-stdio/*-node/workflow.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-stdio/*-node/FAILED.json
